rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved scientific or practice management seminars and meetings; any approved national, state or regional meeting or RACE-approved meeting; online CE and webinars must be RACE-approved or Board-approved
rules.new_licensee_rule: Recent graduates licensed in year 1 of the triennium: 40 h; year 2: 20 h; year 3: exempt for the first renewal.
rules.carryover: Hours over 60 may carry over to the next triennium, max 20 hours.
rules.alternatives: Board may waive CE for qualifying military service personnel.
rules.notes: Triennial license period July 1 - June 30 (current 7/1/2026-6/30/2029). Max 30 h distance education, max 20 h practice management, max 30 h graduate courses per triennium. Hours listed on a Board form signed at renewal.
rules.rule_quote: Within the last three licensing years, each licensee is to complete at least 60 hours of continuing education in courses approved by the board as a condition for license renewal.
